en: A block and tackle pulley system with four rope segments provides a mechanical advantage of exactly four to lift heavy loads.
Ice has a friction coefficient of just 0.03, making it much slipperier than dry rubber on concrete, which has a coefficient of 0.8.
The acceleration due to gravity on Earth is 9.8 meters per second squared, but on the Moon it is only 1.6 meters per second squared.
A strong neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, while a standard ceramic fridge magnet lifts only about half a kilogram.
A standard AA alkaline battery provides 1.5 volts of electrical energy, whereas a typical car battery provides a much larger 12 volts.
Light travels through space at exactly 299,792,458 meters per second, which is roughly 874,000 times faster than sound travels through air.
Sound travels through air at 343 meters per second, but it travels over four times faster through water at 1,480 meters per second.
Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius and freezes at 0 degrees Celsius, meaning liquid water exists within a 100-degree temperature range at sea level.
A standard 60-watt incandescent bulb converts only 5 percent of its electrical energy into visible light, wasting the remaining 95 percent as heat.
In a first-class lever like a seesaw, placing the fulcrum exactly in the center gives a mechanical advantage of exactly one.
A skydiver falling in a belly-to-earth position reaches a maximum terminal velocity of about 54 meters per second due to air friction.
The food you eat contains chemical potential energy; a single medium apple provides about 400,000 joules of energy for your body to use.
